entities.name: The Gathering
entities.description: Summit in 3000 AR at Minorad on Corondor, the first formal convening of the Sages of Minorad, which ended in Ravidel's assault.

entities.name: Sages of Minorad
entities.description: Collective of wizards, druids and scholars dedicated to preserving knowledge and advancing magical understanding.

entities.name: Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad
entities.description: Dating system beginning at year 1 RSM, created at the Gathering.

entities.name: Minorad
entities.description: Site of the spires on Corondor where the Gathering was held.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Land of Dominaria whose northernmost habitable point holds Minorad.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane whose greatest magical minds gathered.

entities.name: Ash Warlord Embereck
entities.description: Native Dominarian planeswalker who warned of future conflicts and abandoned the sages after their surrender.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Native planeswalker forced into servitude under the Scarlet Vizier.

entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: Native planeswalker stripped of his abilities and memory and cursed to wander Corondor.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Native planeswalker who resurrected Ravidel; confined to her enchanted forest.

entities.name: Grenfell Mor
entities.description: Native planeswalker banished to the Sand Seas of Golthonor.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Battlemage and planeswalker who resented the sages and attacked Minorad with the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Weapon of devastating power wielded by Ravidel.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Dark force Ravidel once died fighting.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Dark force Ravidel once died fighting.

entities.name: Sand Seas of Golthonor
entities.description: Place where Grenfell Mor was banished.

events.summary: The greatest magical minds of Dominaria assemble at Minorad in 3000 AR, forming the Sages of Minorad.
events.quote: the first formal convening of the Sages of Minorad

events.summary: The sages establish a unified doctrine and a new dating system, the Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad.
participants: Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad
events.quote: a new system of measuring history, beginning with the year 1 RSM

events.summary: Embereck and others warn of future conflicts during discussions of the multiverse and planeswalking.
events.quote: warned of future conflicts that would test their resolve

events.summary: Ravidel and the Scarlet Vizier launch a sudden assault on Minorad out of resentment toward Kristina.
events.quote: launched a sudden and brutal assault on Minorad

events.summary: Ravidel threatens annihilation with the Golgothian Sylex and forces the sages into an oath of non-interference.
events.quote: he forced the sages to submit to his will

events.summary: Altair is bound to the land, stripped of planeswalker abilities and memory.
Liana is forced into servitude under the Scarlet Vizier.
events.quote: Liana of Minorad was forced into servitude under the Scarlet Vizier

events.summary: Grenfell Mor is banished to the Sand Seas of Golthonor.
events.quote: Grenfell Mor was banished to the Sand Seas of Golthonor

events.summary: Kristina is confined to her enchanted forest.
events.quote: Kristina of the Woods was confined to her enchanted forest

events.summary: Embereck abandons the group in disgust, vowing never to interfere.
